fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Human name for this procedural sound effect, e.g. 'Machine-gun fire' or 'Level-up fanfare'.

fields.name: slug
fields.title: Slug
fields.description: Stable identifier, usually matching the play_<name> entry point in autoload/sfx.gd (e.g. 'fire', 'impact', 'fanfare').

fields.name: synthParams
fields.title: Synthesis parameters
fields.description: The game ships NO sound assets — every clip is synthesised at boot into in-memory AudioStreamWAV buffers. These describe the procedural bake shape.

fields.name: wave
fields.title: Waveform
fields.description: Primary oscillator shape used by the bake (sine, triangle, square, saw, noise) or a mix. Free-text — the bakes layer several partials.

fields.name: freq
fields.title: Base frequency (Hz)
fields.description: Fundamental frequency the clip is baked at, in Hz. Pitch-shifted at play time for tiered clips (kill thump, chime, chain-tier).

fields.name: decay
fields.title: Decay / duration (s)
fields.description: Approximate clip length / decay time in seconds, e.g. 0.025 footstep, 0.15 ding, 0.52 fanfare, 1.2 dashboard-arrival chord.

fields.name: voiceLane
fields.title: Voice lane
fields.description: Which priority pool lane the clip plays on. PROTECTED (2 voices) for long narrative clips that must not be cut mid-clip (fanfare, death stinger, boss-approach stings, Dead-Eye arm). COMBAT (6 voices) for short throughput clips (fire, impact, ding, footstep, etc.). Total 8 voices.

fields.name: triggerSignal
fields.title: Trigger signal
fields.description: The existing Godot signal Sfx lazily connects to (sfx never edits the emitter), e.g. 'combat.fired', 'combat.enemy_hit', 'swarm.enemy_killed', 'PlayerStats.level_up', 'player.damaged', 'crystal_collected'. Contract-only clips have no signal yet and are fired by a manual play_<name>() call.
